resources.string:
For sheets with fields one chooses, each found by its name: foods and their calories, books, plants, contacts.
## What it does
- Other tools can name a sheet, like a meal naming its foods
- Importing a table
## Not made for
- What is noted over time (Tracking, Journal)

## The sheets
A sheet has a name, plus the tool's fields, added in the common settings.

## The table
- Columns of the table: how many fields show after the name

## The table
- Search by name
- Filters
Touch a column's title to sort by it, and touch it again to reverse the order.
- {plus} New sheet
- Import a file: a CSV table, one row per sheet

## A sheet
Touch a row to open its sheet.
- {chevron-left} Previous sheet
- {chevron-right} Next sheet
- Change
- {trash} Deletes the sheet
Sheets with the fields you choose, each found by its name, for foods, books, plants or anything else
How many of the user\'s fields (extra_fields, in their order) the table shows after the name
